hypothesis_title: Regime-Conditional Dynamic Blending Alpha — Meta-Allocation via BOCPD + Hyperbolic Alpha Decay + Black-Litterman

selected_hypothesis.label: DYN_BLEND_BL_BOCPD_HYP_v1
selected_hypothesis.mechanism_summary: STR_1715 (PG2 100%) blend weight를 동적으로 조절하여 alpha 생성. 3 pillar: Pillar A (BOCPD on STR_1715 monthly returns + existing 3-layer macro regime score → combined risk-off detection). Pillar B (hyperbolic alpha decay α(t)=K/(1+λt) on rolling 36-month STR_1715 excess returns → forward expected return view). Pillar C (Black-Litterman with regime prior + Pillar B view → STR_1715 vs Cash binary allocation). 본 WT의 alpha vector는 weight schedule 시계열 자체 (factor_engine_continuous label).
selected_hypothesis.expected_role: PG2_META_ALLOCATION_OVERLAY (sleeve = STR_1715 sleeve + Cash sleeve, AX-007 EXCEPTION_1 multi-sleeve via regime overlay 정합)
selected_hypothesis.why_now: STR_1715 (PG2 100% Forge realized SR 1.4625) baseline에서 단일 MRS overlay 10/20/40% cash 정태 규칙 대비 우월성 입증 가능 가설. 36-month rolling alpha decay × regime 결합은 fixed-rule 대비 dynamic optimal 우위 학술 검증 (Shu-Mulvey 2024 IR 0.4-0.5).

literature_anchors.role: Pillar A+C primary architectural template (SJM + BL)
Student-t HMM > Gaussian + Granger 9d lead time
Pillar B hyperbolic decay K/(1+λt) R²=0.65 mechanism
Drift regime overlay validation template (1000 trials p<0.001)
KR investor flow daily MI=0 → monthly horizon validate

selected_hypothesis.kr_empirical_status: Direct 2/12 (L10 KAIST + L11 KR investor flow). Architectural portability 11/12. Shu-Mulvey + RegimeFolio = 본 WT가 KR 1차 검증 (mandate).

ax_compliance.AX-001_v2: 조건부 평가 만족: meta-allocation은 STR_1715 (Core_Alpha) sleeve + Cash sleeve = 2-sleeve 구조. Crisis_alpha 측정 (8 stress periods 비교). Bad/normal IC ratio 측정 (regime conditional). MDD complement vs STR_1715 100% baseline 비교.
ax_compliance.AX-002: Forge harness 산출 SR만 유효. 본 alpha는 weight schedule 시계열을 alpha_scores.parquet으로 저장 (Date × {weight_str1715, weight_cash}). Risk Agent가 본 weight schedule + STR_1715 returns 결합 후 risk model 생성. PIT t-1 lag 전수 검증.
ax_compliance.AX-005_avoidance: BAB Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 standalone 미사용 (single-sleeve long-only top20 회피). Q07+D25 single-sleeve combo도 미사용. 본 구조는 meta-layer = STR_1715 sleeve + Cash sleeve, AX-005 자연스럽게 회피.
ax_compliance.AX-007_EXCEPTION_1: long_only_top20 single_sleeve 회피. 본 구조는 multi-sleeve via regime overlay 정합 (STR_1715 sleeve + Cash sleeve, weight 동적 조절).
ax_compliance.AX-008: Verification Triangulation: Forge backtest (TBD by next agent) + Codex critique (필수, run_codex_qepm_critic.sh) + Architect 자체 검증 (lookahead_detector + audit). 3-of-3 PASS 목표.
